hook: A Los Angeles judge sealed records in a $600 million battle.

sections.voiceover: A Los Angeles judge sealed records in a $600 million battle.
b_roll: Graphic depiction of a courtroom gavel slamming onto confidential estate documents

sections.voiceover: On October 29, 2026, Paris Jackson petitioned a Los Angeles court. Her filing demanded $600 million move into the family trust. Can executor John Branca hide those financial records?
b_roll: Motion graphic timeline highlighting October 29, 2026 filing date
Animated split-screen showing Paris Jackson filing papers alongside the $600 million trust figure
Graphic illustration of estate executor John Branca with sealed document icons

sections.voiceover: But in November 2026, a Los Angeles judge allowed executor John Branca to keep key documents sealed.
b_roll: Animated lock mechanism securing financial documents dated November 2026

sections.voiceover: Beneficiaries Prince Jackson and Bigi Jackson remain in the dispute. A court set a December 4, 2026 hearing on the petition.
b_roll: Graphic news report headline referencing Page Six legal reporting
Motion graphic listing beneficiaries Prince Jackson and Bigi Jackson
Calendar graphic zooming in on December 4, 2026 hearing date

sections.voiceover: The $600 million trust battle returns to court on December 4.
b_roll: Summary graphic displaying $600 million trust amount with court date
